intro.text: Someone a letter-writer reports dead along with Skai, with what the two of them held now Splintered.
Someone who, with Skai, is dead, what they held now Splintered; a letter-writer calls the pair foolish for violating a pact from the very beginning.
One of the Shards. She and Skai settled in the same place, against the Shards' agreement, and both are dead, their power Splintered.

items.text: Aona came from Yolen, where she was a healer. Tanavast remembered her as always being kind to him, and as one of the best of the people who took part in the Shattering.
Odium set Aona and Skai against each other, then killed them both while the struggle had left them weak.
